resumen: A sport of short, repeated efforts where almost every serious injury happens while sprinting or decelerating.
exigencias: Fatigue resistance in the second half
enfoque: Posterior-chain strength all year round, not only in pre-season
GPS load monitoring to avoid stacking spikes

resumen: Constant contact, jumps with unbalanced landings, and a shoulder that throws thousands of times per season.
exigencias: Changes of pace in tight spaces
enfoque: Shoulder and scapular stability as the base, not an add-on
Unilateral strength work to even out both sides

resumen: High volumes and narrow margins: strength work has to add value without stealing energy from the track.
enfoque: Maximal strength with low volume and high quality
Plyometrics dosed around the competition calendar
Close monitoring of Achilles tendon load

resumen: A markedly asymmetric sport, with an enormous load on one hand, one shoulder and one side of the body.
exigencias: Health of the dominant hand and shoulder
enfoque: Compensating the non-dominant side in every session
Rotator strength and scapular control throughout the season
Logging striking volume as if it were training load
